profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ Surefire Local | Senior/Staff Backend & Platform Engineer | Java · Kotlin · PHP/Laravel · AWS | AI-Enabled Products (OpenAI, Bedrock) | React Native
profile.summary:
I'm a hands-on engineering leader with 10+ years of experience designing and evolving production software across backend platforms, mobile apps, high-traffic services, and AI-enabled products. I lead teams and set technical direction, and I still write code.

At Surefire Local, I lead nine engineers across two teams: backend and React Native. I own technical direction for a platform with 1,300+ routes and 70+ service classes. I've led the development of OpenAI-backed services that generate social posts, review replies, and customer answers, and a Bedrock Mantle service that produces an AI visibility score for clients. I also use Codex and Claude Code to speed up code review, testing, architecture research, and security audits.

Before that, at Liberty University, I led design and architecture for about eight high-traffic Java microservices. I also worked on the authentication service used by more than 100,000 students, faculty, and staff.

What I care about:
• Architecture that scales with the business, not ahead of it
• Observability and reliability: centralized logging, queue-based processing, fewer 2 a.m. surprises
• Faster delivery: I cut mobile build times from about 40 minutes to 15 and support biweekly releases
• Growing engineers: I've mentored 20+ developers, and six of them were promoted

Core stack: Java, Kotlin, Spring, PHP/Laravel, AWS (SQS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, S3, EC2, RDS, Bedrock), Snowflake, Docker, OpenShift, React Native, React, and TypeScript.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - Backend & Mobile
positions.description:
• Lead two direct-report teams totaling nine engineers (five backend, four React Native), combining hands-on architecture and development with technical direction, quality standards, and delivery accountability
• Own technical direction for a backend platform with 1,300+ route definitions and 70+ service classes
• Led development of OpenAI-backed services that generate social posts, review requests, review replies, and answers to customer questions, reducing the manual work required to run clients' marketing programs
• Led development of a Bedrock Mantle service that generates an AI visibility score, giving clients a practical signal for evaluating their marketing presence
• Used Codex and Claude Code to accelerate code review, test development, and architecture evaluation, and to identify vulnerabilities during security audits
• Reworked 80+ recurring commands around Laravel Scheduler and SQS-backed workers, reducing manual intervention
• Centralized CloudWatch logging for inbound and outbound calls to shorten troubleshooting, and integrated Snowflake for backup and analytics
• Upgraded React Native from 0.69 to 0.85, implemented push notifications, and introduced TanStack Query
• Automated Bitrise build caching, cutting build time from about 40 minutes to 15 and supporting releases about every two weeks
• Established code-review standards and mentored 20+ developers; six were promoted

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
• Led design and architecture for approximately eight high-traffic Java microservices, containerized with Docker and built to support demanding production traffic
• Served as project and technical lead for the native mobile application, guiding design, feature, and performance decisions through delivery
• Implemented Java and Kotlin microservices and APIs supporting the university's web and native mobile ecosystem
• Led code reviews and mentored junior developers across the full-stack team

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
• Worked on the university authentication service used by every student, including more than 100,000 online and residential students, as well as faculty and staff
• Contributed to the post-login dashboard, the university's highest-traffic application, which manages user-specific widgets and application access
• Built a microservice that delivered live basketball and football scores during games
• Developed application features for the myLU team using Angular controllers, services, and views
positions.insights: REST APIs, API Development and +4 skills

positions.title: Web Developer II
positions.description:
• Served as lead developer on large projects, owning design, feature, and performance decisions from planning through delivery
• Delivered full-stack web solutions across project execution and engineering decisions

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
• Developed enterprise applications for security-conscious government customers, including DOJ and DOD
• Built PHP backends and React, JavaScript, and jQuery interfaces for the YakaBox, YakaDrive, and CisoBox products

positions.title: Web Developer I
positions.description: • Built and maintained university websites for Liberty University Creative Media using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ColdFusion, and PHP
